title: Plasma AI Formally Proves Erdős Problem #173 on Monochromatic Congruent Triangles in the Plane
aiSystem: Plasma AI (GPT-6 Astra + Claude Opus 5.5 + Lean 4)
whyItMatters: Resolves the 53-year-old 1973 Erdős–Graham–Montgomery–Rothschild–Spencer–Straus problem in Euclidean Ramsey theory with a Comparator-checked Lean 4 proof.
summary: Plasma AI combined GPT-6 Astra (in OpenAI Codex) and Claude Opus 5.5 (in Claude Code), building on OpenAI’s open-source Lean rigidity library, to autonomously discover and formally verify a complete Lean 4 proof of Erdős Problem #173 (posed in 1973). The theorem proves that in any arbitrary 2-coloring of the Euclidean plane ℝ², every non-equilateral triangle—including collinear triples—admits a monochromatic congruent copy, verified against Comparator with standard Lean axioms only.
technicalHighlights: Resolves Erdős Problem #173 (Erdős–Graham–Montgomery–Rothschild–Spencer–Straus, 1973), open for 53 years.
Establishes monochromatic congruent copies for all non-equilateral triangles (and degenerate collinear triples) in every 2-coloring of ℝ².
Fully formalized in Lean 4 and validated via Comparator using only standard axioms, publicly auditable on GitHub.
caveats: Published as a public Lean 4 GitHub repository rather than a peer-reviewed journal paper, though the mathematical statement and proof are machine-checked by Lean 4 and Comparator.
